dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250804-SDN-01](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250804-SDN-01) A flood occurred on Aug 04 2025 in Sudan. It affected an estimated 340470 people and 533962 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
